name: Cellular Automata
desc: A coarse life-grid ticks forward on every beat while its ruleset mutates each section — Conway to HighLife to Day&Night — rendered as glowing green CRT phosphor with scanline roll and blinking cursor.

hue.doc: cell hue (terminal green default; try 30 amber, 300 magenta)

fade.doc: afterglow / trail persistence of dying cells

style.doc: aesthetic: glowing green CRT phosphor blocks + scanlines / soft organic mossy blotches on stone / cold faceted ice crystals / dot-matrix ASCII glyphs by age (abstract)

act.doc: drift = steady rule morphs w/ small reseeds / bloom = large section-locked reseed blooms that pulse with intensity
